items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: You know Manuel Perez, the trumpet player. ... He was, Manuel Perez also was with, one time, they had, let's see, what was the name of his band? ... Manuel played a lot of times with him [Celestine].

ctx.x: Well, it'll come to you the minute we think about something else. Yeah.

It'll come to me. Well, he used to play piano there at Cadillac. My Uncle played, uh, uh, Uncle Dave sometime used to play, Dave Depass used to play clarinet. Well, that's my husband's brother. He used to play sometime with your Daddy, you know. Jimmy Newman was playing there also one time at the Cadillac. Until he went away and we had that cook auction with him. And, uh, they used to play at the fairgrounds, you see. They had the Armist brass band at the fairgrounds. And they had the young Olympians who were…

items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: He was a little saxophone player... And I think he used to be a whole lot with D.D.

ctx.x: The man in Prayer, he was living right next to that stage.
Oh, yeah. Sure. He was a little saxophone player. Saxophone, kind of thing. Oh, yeah. And I think he used to be a whole lot with D.D.
